title: Stale doc comment: awaiting/2 claims a seed fallback that the code does not implement
detail: The comment promises a fallback to the seed rows when the dict key is absent, but awaiting_for returns an empty list. Nothing crashes either way, so the comment misleads future readers about the fallback contract.
recommended_fix: Fix the comment to say an unknown vacancy yields an empty pool (or actually fall back to seed_awaiting() rows if the seed-fallback behaviour was intended).

title: remind_applicant double-scans the row list and reports a follow-up for an unknown email
evidence:
let sent_reminded =
    list.contains(list.map(rows, fn(a) { a.email }), email)
    && list.find(rows, fn(a) { a.email == email })
    |> result.map(fn(a) { !a.reminded })
    |> result.unwrap(False)
detail: list.contains followed by list.find scans rows twice; find alone carries the same information. When the email is absent the function still returns #(0, 1), claiming a follow-up was sent for a row that does not exist (demo UI only sends known emails, so latent).
recommended_fix: Replace with a single list.find: case find -> Ok(a) -> #(!a.reminded, a.reminded) mapped to #(1,0)/#(0,1); Error -> #(store, #(0, 0)) so unknown emails report nothing sent.

title: Test helper result_map_custom re-implements gleam/result.map
detail: This is gleam/result.map verbatim. The test file already imports gleam/list, gleam/string, gleam/option; a hand-rolled duplicate adds noise against the repo's DRY convention.
recommended_fix: Drop result_map_custom, add `import gleam/result` and call result.map at the two use sites.

title: Report-fixture truth now triplicated: pdf_prebake hardcodes docs/income/extras that must mirror client demo fixtures
detail: documents_for, income_sources_for and extras_for hardcode per-applicant data that duplicates client/src/demo/demo_store.gleam's documents_for; agreement is manual and unpinned by any test, so a fixture edit silently desyncs PDF from app. Also pushes pdf_prebake.gleam to 851 lines vs the AGENTS.md <200 logic-module target. Demo-only, pre-existing pattern, hence note not warning.
recommended_fix: Acceptable to ship; consider a shared fixture source or a pin test asserting pdf_prebake doc counts per applicant equal demo_store's document lists, so drift fails make test.
